detail: Created evidence root, snapshotted sender v1, started desktop recording, sender and simulator.
Quest connected; v1 rejected the Android outer packet wrapper. Operator later reported green square and data reception error. No video access unit was sent.
Corrected wrapper parsing passed three tests and a full wrapped-control mock receiving ten H.264 access units.
Corrected sender connected and sent one access unit; video connection ended with broken pipe and headset sent CLOSE_CAMERA.
Second corrected Listen attempt connected to Quest 10.9.0.127:12345 and began sustained 2560x720 H.264 streaming.
Operator reported seeing the desktop in the headset. Tracking reconnect restored controller operation after a stale connection.
Operator reported right and left simulated arms moved during same-side grip stages while viewing the return stream.
Operator reported released-grip reposition did not move the arm, then reported bimanual control working.
Headset sent CLOSE_CAMERA after 11400 logged frames; stream ended. Simulator, sender and recorder were deliberately stopped and exact PIDs were absent.
